description: The voicebot speaks `text` aloud in the call (verbatim in normal mode; in a live room the voice rephrases it and the answer has verbatim false, mode live_paraphrase). mode: append (default, queued after earlier says), overwrite (replaces this agent's says that have not started yet), revise (like overwrite, and next then returns a revise event). ref (optional) ties the sentence to a card or decision: the person sees it highlighted while you speak. Returns ok and seq.

ref.description: Optional: the card or decision this sentence is about, "card:<card id>" (id from show) or "decision:<number>". While the sentence plays, the person sees it highlighted (its window opens if closed). Unknown ids are ignored, the sentence is spoken anyway.
ref.title: Ref

name: say
title: Speak in the call
